title: ZAP
description: Play ZAP, the thrilling online puzzle card game! Match cards by color or number to clear your hand and block opponents. Fast-paced, fun, and competitive - perfect for card game lovers!

title: 4 Colors
description:
Get ready to challenge up to three computer opponents in this game!

Strategize your moves and be the first to get rid of your cards by matching them by color or number.

But be careful, if you forget to shout ""Uno"" when you have only one card left, you'll face a penalty of two extra cards!

And don't forget about the action cards – they can bring a whole new level of chaos and confusion to the game!

title: Solitaire
description: Enjoy four classic solitaire experiences in one polished card game collection. Play Spider, FreeCell, Klondike, and Pyramid with smooth controls, relaxing gameplay, and beautiful casino-inspired visuals. Whether you want a quick challenge or a calm card session, 4 in 1 Solitaire offers endless fun for every card game fan.

title: TCG Shop: Dino Adventure
description: A prehistoric trading-card shop game. Battle league rivals in 3v3 fights where a card’s power is both its attack and its health. Win to earn coins and climb the league ladder, then spend coins on packs and tap to open them. After each pull, swipe left to sell for coins or right to sleeve the card into your binder. Repeat the loop to grow your deck, rise through the leagues, and complete your collection.

title: 4 Color Card Game
description: 4 Color Card Game is a fast-paced, easy-to-learn card game perfect for players of all ages. The goal is simple: match cards by color or number and be the first to get rid of all your cards. With action cards that can change the flow of the game in an instant, every round is full of surprises and fun. Whether you're playing with friends, family, or challenging opponents online, 4 Color Card Game delivers quick, exciting matches that keep you coming back for more.

title: Durak
description:
Durak is essentially a shedding card game where each player will try to get rid of the cards in their hand first. Durak is quite an enjoyable game that has over the years made a general impact on millions. It is a game that requires critical thinking, which is why it is more popular among people who consider themselves tech-savvy.

The objective of Durak is to play all your cards. The loser in Durak will be the last player with cards in their hand. So, to ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can.

Durak is the most popular Russian card game. Durak means fool and it refers to the person who loses the game.

A Durak card game is one of the easiest and most fun card games. Players do not need much to get started. You will only need: a poker deck reduced to 36 cards from Ace to 6.

However, this game is quite interesting because there will usually be multiple winners. To ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can.


Durak might not be a game you are overly familiar with. But in Russia, Durak is by far the most popular card game! It has got a fascinating history and will be sure to make a unique choice if you are looking for something a little different.

Another interesting thing about this game is that it is played with a smaller deck.

Durak is fun and, rather, a unique card game. If you enjoy more strategic card games and are looking for something a little different, why not give Durak a try?

title: Build levels – earn money!
description: Get ready for an addictive challenge! Tap the screen to release balls and aim for the holes in each round. After every round, hit the store to grab powerful upgrades and cool items to boost your progress. Complete levels, collect diamonds, and unlock permanent upgrades to level up faster. How far can you push your skills? The further you go, the bigger the rewards!

title: Build levels – earn money!
description: Get ready for an addictive challenge! Tap the screen to release balls and aim for the holes in each round. After every round, hit the store to grab powerful upgrades and cool items to boost your progress. Complete levels, collect diamonds, and unlock permanent upgrades to level up faster. How far can you push your skills? The further you go, the bigger the rewards!

title: Build levels – earn money!
description: Get ready for an addictive challenge! Tap the screen to release balls and aim for the holes in each round. After every round, hit the store to grab powerful upgrades and cool items to boost your progress. Complete levels, collect diamonds, and unlock permanent upgrades to level up faster. How far can you push your skills? The further you go, the bigger the rewards!

title: Cards in Fool
description: Play Cards in Fool – a strategic turn-based online card game! Outsmart opponents, make them draw cards, and climb the leaderboard. Flip cards, win matches, and earn points in this classic multiplayer challenge!

title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks 4
description: The highly anticipated 4th installation of one of the most popular Solitaire Card Games of all time! Foxy, the game’s cute little character, will take you on a journey to new destinations, visiting distant countries, fantastic landscapes, and famous landmarks including Australia, Antigua and Barbuda, Antarctica, Peru, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Majorca and the Easter Island in Chile! With incredible 3500+ levels, Solitaire Story TriPeaks 4 is one of the deepest Solitaire games of all time.

title: Solitaire Story Tripeaks 6
description: The highly anticipated 6th installment of one of the most popular Solitaire Story card games of all time! Your good friend Foxy will take you on a journey to new destinations, visiting countries, landscapes, and landmarks like Japan, Egypt, Brazil, Korea, New Zealand, Madagascar, North Pole, and Fiji. With 6700+ levels, Daily Missions, Weekly Air Balloon and Pet Events, and dozens of new card designs, this is the biggest Solitaire Story game yet!

title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks 5
description: The highly anticipated 5th installation of one of the most popular Solitaire Card Games of all time! Foxy, the game’s cute little character, will take you on a journey to new destinations, visiting distant countries, fantastic landscapes, and famous landmarks.

title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 4
description: Solitaire Farm: Seasons 4 is here with over 3,800+ levels and fresh adventures! Explore beautiful new maps like Greenland, South Korea, Sumatra, and Nepal while growing unique crops such as Mountain Avens, Ginkgo, Durian, Flax, and Orchids. With new level packs, seasonal events, and charming visuals, this relaxing solitaire journey is more exciting than ever. Ready to train your brain and enjoy country life? Dive into the adventure now!

title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 3
description: Solitaire Farm: Seasons 3, the highly anticipated sequel, continues the charming farm theme of Seasons 1 and 2 with incredible 3,400+ levels! Train your brain with diverse solitaire puzzles while enjoying country life. Explore new scenes and travel to new countries. Grow new crops such as Gooseberry, Foxgloves, Celery, Papyrus, Loquat, Prickly Pears, Berseem, and Blackberries. Enjoy stunning visuals and engaging gameplay in this delightful solitaire adventure!

title: Winter Solitaire TriPeaks
description:
Take a break from the holiday bustle and unwind with Winter Solitaire TriPeaks!
Play over 500 frosty levels and clear shimmering, ice-covered tableaus. Escape into a peaceful winter wonderland filled with enchanting scenes that evolve as you build magical locations throughout the game. From a cozy cottage to a snow-dusted palace, every setting is a feast for the eyes.

Discover the most heart-warming Solitaire experience of the season — and let the snowflakes guide your cards to victory!

title: Tripeaks Solitaire Escapes
description: Play Solitaire TriPeaks Escapes, a relaxing card game with a warm summer vibe. Explore hundreds of unique solitaire levels featuring stunning graphics and vibrant beach landscapes. Master challenging card puzzles using powerful boosters, train your brain and sharpen your strategy. Dive into this colorful TriPeaks world and enjoy a soothing, slow-paced adventure. Escape the daily grind and find your zen in every hand you play!

title: CityMix Solitaire
description:
Play card games, relax and train your memory and brain with CityMix Solitaire. Solitaire CityMix is more than just another game♠♥♠♥!
Which would you prefer: decorating and restoring a quiet town, or solving puzzles and seeking adventure on a lost island? With CityMix Solitaire you can decorate, solve puzzles and mysteries, follow adventures and help brave heroes. Vicky and her pet Raccoon will help in this challenging quest.

title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 5
description: Solitaire Farm Season 5 is here with over 4,200+ levels and fresh adventures! Explore beautiful new maps, grow unique crops, and enjoy even more relaxing solitaire fun. With new level packs, seasonal events, and charming visuals, this countryside journey is more exciting than ever. Ready to train your brain and enjoy farm life? Dive into the adventure now!

title: Jewel Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Rebuild glorious castles in a magical Solitaire adventure! Conquer 200 levels, master 12 variants – from Klondike to Spider – and enjoy fresh mechanics that reinvent the classic. The kingdom’s fate lies in your cards – are you ready to play your way to glory?

title: Solitaire Winter
description:
It’s cold outside and you’re snowed in with a game of Solitaire! Travel the icy land and rebuild 5 beautiful winter locations across 200 levels, plus unlock 18 bonus game variants like Klondike, Spider and Freecell!

Overcome obstacles like locks, frozen cards, chains, vines, and more to collect the bonus gems and coins in each level which you can spend in the shop for upgrades. 

Choose between multiple card decks, but don’t freeze up as you go for the elusive 3 stars on every level!

title: Solitaire L'Amour
description: Love is in the air. And so is Solitaire! Enter an enchanting world as you fall head over heels for this charming new Solitaire adventure!

title: Solitaire Emperor - Secrets of Fate
description:
Enter the magical world of Tarot in this captivating solitaire adventure! Each card tells a story, and every level presents a new puzzle. Meet iconic Tarot characters like the wise Hermit and bold Knight of Swords as they guide your journey.
A dark sorcerer threatens to unravel the Arcana's magic—only you can uncover its secrets, solve riddles, and restore balance. Will your intuition and strategy save this mystical realm?

title: Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Step into the shadows with Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks! Explore abandoned castles, fend off lurking vampires, and rebuild forgotten halls. Play 200+ haunting Solitaire levels plus 50 chilling Mahjong boards. Face spooky twists like frozen and locked cards, tricky obstacles, and powerful boosts. Search the dark, cobwebby corners of every last level for gems and coins to purchase new castle upgrades and power-ups. Are you ready for a Solitaire adventure that sends shivers down your spine?

title: Gin Rummy
description: "Gin Rummy" is a classic and engaging card game where the goal is to strategically arrange your hand into sets and runs. Place your cards in either groups of the same rank or in sequential order of the same suit. Score points by eliminating these combinations from your hand. The game ends when a player reaches the target score, typically set at 100 points.

title: Solitaire 13in1 Collection
description: Popular solitaire is simple and addictive game for one player, which goal is to get rid of all the cards on the table, with the help of certain rules. Every of the thirteen modes are following different rules. Among them we will find popular variants like Klondike or Freecell. Can you win all of them?

title: Solitaire Tripeaks
description: Explore the mysteries of the Deep Sea with Solitaire TriPeaks, the classic solitaire card game which allows you to train your brain with different solitaire puzzles.

title: Best Classic Freecell Solitaire
description: Welcome to FreeCell Solitaire! Dive into this classic card game where strategy and patience are key. With all cards visible from the start, plan your moves carefully to arrange them into the foundation piles by suit, from Ace to King. Use the free cells wisely to maneuver your way out of tight spots. Are you ready to tackle the challenge and clear the board? Play the Best Classic FreeCell Solitaire now and put your skills to the test!

title: Palm Island Solitaire
description:
Palm Island Solitaire – Your Tropical Card Challenge! ☀️

Catch the island breeze with Palm Island Solitaire, a fresh twist on Golf Solitaire that blends strategy with sunny vibes.

Score low, reshuffle when needed, and enjoy every move with playful golf lingo and island flair.

Ready to relax, play smart, and swing into fun?  Let the adventure begin!

title: Spider Solitaire
description: Get ready to dive into the timeless classic Spider Solitaire, reimagined for mobile with sleek design and intuitive gameplay! Perfect for players of all skill levels, this game offers a relaxing yet challenging card puzzle experience anytime, anywhere.

title: Solitaire Daily
description: Your favorite dose of daily solitaire is here! Come back everyday to sit back, relax and play a game of cards! Do you have what it takes to become an absolute Solitaire master? Try it now.

title: Emilys Hotel Solitaire
description: What are you going to do when you go on a journey to a tropical island? Will you spend your time in a lounger, enjoying the hot sun and cold drinks, or become a master surfer? Our heroine Emily has arrived at this heavenly place to make her honorable grandfather Douglas Kirby’s dream to build a hotel of his own come true.

title: Mahjong Four Rivers
description: Discover the engaging world of Mahjong Four Rivers – a fresh take on the classic puzzle game. With its traditional charm and modern gameplay, it’s perfect for sharpening your observation and strategy skills. Enjoy beautifully designed tiles and the rewarding challenge of clearing the board. Play for free on your phone or computer, wherever you are.

title: Solitaire Deluxe Edition
description:
Everyone's favorite classic card game is back. And this time, it's even more fancy and awesome!

Feast your eyes on the classic game that has been upgraded to look even better than before. Try your hand once again and see if you can beat it like you used to.

Is it all skill or does luck have some say in the matter? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Fortune's Deck Solitaire
description:
Welcome to Fortune's Deck Solitaire, where ancient Tarot magic meets the timeless thrill of Tripeaks!

Three enchanted towers of fate await your touch - draw from the mystical deck and begin your journey through the arcana.

Inspired by the classic Tripeaks Solitaire, this magical twist invites you to clear the cards, trust your intuition, and let the deck reveal your fortune.

Will you find insight, mystery… or unexpected luck?

title: Solitaire Klondike
description:
Step into the timeless challenge of Solitaire Klondike, an addictive HTML5 card game designed for fans of classic solitaire. Enjoy hours of relaxing gameplay with this popular version of Klondike Solitaire, where players arrange cards in descending order and alternate colors to win. If you need a fresh start, simply shuffle new cards to explore different winning strategies!
Perfect for anyone who loves solitaire,  Solitaire Klondike combines strategy, patience, and quick thinking.

title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
description:
Ready to experience a summer full of Solitaire?
Finally, it's summer! Time to relax! What's better than to lay back, listen to the smooth tunes, enjoy the warm breeze coming from the sea and play some Klondike Solitaire.
Your goal in Solitaire Summer is simple, yet so addictive: Arrange all cards sorted by color in 4 stacks, from lowest to highest value. Can you remove all cards in the correct order and solve the Solitaire Summer puzzle?

title: Pyramid Solitaire
description: Pyramid Solitaire is an exciting HTML5 game that offers a modern twist on the classic Pyramid Solitaire experience. Enjoy its sleek design while you strategically match cards to clear the pyramid. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the game, this version promises both fun and challenge.

title: Master Addiction Solitaire
description:
Challenge yourself and take on this brain teaser of a solitaire game!

Masterfully rearrange the cards so they end up in ascending order, from A to 6

If you need some help, there are hints, undos, and shuffle that you can use

title: Galactic Golf Solitaire
description:
Enjoy a relaxing round of Golf Solitaire, a fun and easy-to-play card game. The goal is to clear the board by matching cards that are one rank higher or lower than the one on the discard pile. Don’t worry about suits—just focus on the numbers! If you’re stuck, you can draw from the deck to keep the game going. Play at your own pace and see how many rounds you can win.

Perfect for a quick break or to unwind at the end of the day!

title: TriPeaks Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with Tri Peaks Solitaire, a captivating twist on the classic solitaire! Clear all cards from the three pyramids by removing them in ascending or descending order. With polished graphics and relaxing gameplay, each match is a perfect blend of strategy and fun.

title: Cards Match Puzzle
description: Jump into Cards Match Puzzle, where matching cards is your ticket to addictive fun! Place cards on a grid to create killer combos—think 2-3-4 or four cards for massive points. Wild jokers shake things up, slipping into any sequence, while frozen cards dare you to crack them loose. Boost your score with dazzling multipliers and watch matches explode! Quick to learn, tough to master—can you rule the grid? Play now and match your way to glory!

title: Fireside Solitaire
description:
Fireside Solitaire is a cozy card puzzle that combines logic and relaxation by the warmth of a crackling fire.
Place cards in sequence — one rank higher or lower than the current open card — to clear all columns.
Think ahead: once the draw pile runs out, it can’t be reshuffled, and the game ends.
Enjoy calm music, soft light, and the comforting atmosphere of a winter evening by the fireplace.

title: Klondike Solitaire
description:
Test your skill and logic with Klondike, the classic solitaire game loved by generations!

Stack the cards in ascending order, alternating colors, and complete all four suits to win the game.

With clean graphics, intuitive controls, and the option to play with one or three cards, Klondike offers hours of fun and relaxation.

Perfect for a quick break or a long strategic challenge!

title: Jungle Solitaire
description: Jungle Spider Solitaire is an adaptation of the classic card game Spider Solitaire with a jungle theme. It is optimized for short games and encourages strategic planning of moves with an original system of collecting diamonds.

title: Office Spider Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Spider Solitaire is to clear the table by creating suited sets from king to ace. The game has either one, two or four suits depending on the difficulty setting.

title: 21 Cards
description: 21 Cards is a fun and addictive blackjack-style puzzle game where your goal is to reach exactly 21 points in each column. The game combines the thrill of classic card play with a cozy, home-style atmosphere. Place cards wisely, complete columns, and aim for the perfect 21!

title: Solitaire Quest
description:
Solitaire Quest is a beautifully designed classic Klondike solitaire game.

Enjoy smooth gameplay, elegant visuals, and a relaxing card experience optimized for TV and desktop.

Whether you're a beginner or a solitaire master, challenge yourself and improve your strategy with every game.

title: Cards 2048
description: Are you looking for a fresh twist on a familiar game? Cards 2048 is the perfect blend of classic solitaire and the popular 2048 puzzle game! This unique combination creates an engaging brain teaser that's highly addictive. As you merge cards with matching numbers, the challenge intensifies, offering a true test of your skill and strategy. Sharpen your logic and enjoy hours of fun with Cards 2048, the ultimate card merging game for puzzle enthusiasts!

title: Solitaire Classic
description: The most popular card game in the world, classic Solitaire, also known as Patience, is a great way to relax and train your brain. With beautiful graphics, fun animations, new features, custom backgrounds and offline play - Solitaire by Albayoo is the ideal game for the best casual gaming experience, however, most importantly – this online strategy game helps TRAIN YOUR BRAIN and KEEP YOUR MIND SHARP!

title: Spider Solitaire
description: Experience Spider Solitaire, one of the popular single-player card games. Arrange cards in descending order and form complete sets of the same suit from King to Ace to remove them. The challenge is to organize two decks into eight tableau piles. With strategic thinking and skill, try to uncover all cards and complete the eight sets. There are varying difficulty levels based on the number of different suits (Diamonds, Spades, Hearts, Clubs) you choose to play with.

title: Spider Solitaire
description:
Challenge yourself with this captivating solitaire inspired by the classic Spider card game!

Arrange all the cards on the table into complete sequences of the same suit (from King to Ace), testing your logic, strategy, and patience.

Choose your difficulty level, play with one, two, or all four suits, and prove your skills with the deck.

Every move counts—can you complete all the sequences before running out of options?

title: Scorpion Solitaire
description: Scorpion Solitaire is a solitaire card game in which the goal is to build 4 columns down by suit from K to A. If you do not have a step to move the card, you will lose the game.

title: Mahjong Match Club
description: Select 2 identical mahjongs and eliminate them. After elimination, a green movable area will appear. Move a piece of mahjong until there is no obstruction in the horizontal or vertical direction. It is facing an identical mahjong. Let go and they will disappear automatically. You will gain points and enter the next level. . The game is a test of vision and strategy. Can you complete the challenge?

title: Solitaire Klondike - Treasure Island
description:
Set sail on a thrilling pirate adventure! Explore mysterious islands, uncover hidden treasures, and help a fearless heroine escape ruthless villains.
Customize your experience with beautifully illustrated card decks, stunning animations, and magical boosters to tackle challenges.
Relax between games with mesmerizing music and lively animated characters. Dive into a world of adventure, mystery, and enchantment!

title: Solitaire Match
description: Let's develop the village by accumulating coins in Solitaire. When you match cards to make a total of 10, the cards will disappear, earning you coins. Continue removing cards until there are no more matching combinations, and clear the stage by achieving the coin quota. If the quota is not achieved and the slots become full, it's a failure. Earn more coins by matching combinations with a greater number of cards or by continuously matching cards in a short amount of time.

title: FreeCell
description: Unlike other card games that rely on luck, almost every game of FreeCell is solvable—if you have the skill. Use the four open "free cells" as temporary holders to juggle your cards and organize the chaotic tableau. Plan your moves carefully, stack cards by alternating colors, and clear the board. Whether you want a relaxing break or a serious brain workout, this is the perfect puzzle for you.

title: Office Pyramid Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Pyramid Solitaire is to clear the card pyramid. On hard difficulty you must also clear the draw deck.

title: Golf Solitaire
description:
Golf Solitaire is a fun and relaxing card game that combines simple rules with strategic thinking.

The goal is to clear all the cards from the tableau by moving them to the discard pile one by one, following a sequence either one rank higher or lower, regardless of suit.

For example, you can place a 6 or an 8 on top of a 7. If no moves are available, you draw the next card from the deck.

The game ends when no more moves can be made or the tableau is cleared.

title: Office Solitaire
description: Office Solitaire is the classic solitaire variant with the objective of collecting all the cards to the top row in suited sequences from ace to king.

title: Solitaire Tail
description: Raise your dragons at Solitaire! Clear the game by moving all cards to the foundation! Move cards from the tableau or stockpile in ascending order of the same suit. In the tableau, you can stack cards in descending order with alternating colors! You can place a King card in an empty column! When there are no available moves, you can draw cards from the stockpile to the foundation or tableau!

title: Addiction Mini Solitaire
description: Mini version of Addiction Solitaire. Use empty spots to arrange all cards in color and in sequence from A to 6. You can move a card to a gap if it is the same color and 1 higher in value than the card to the left of the gap. You have 1 reshuffle. After the Ace you need to place a 2 and then ascending to 6.

title: Strawberry Shortcake BoardGames
description: Visit the BerryWorks cafeteria and play checkers, memory, tic-tac-toe, connecting pairs, and complete jigsaw puzzles with your friends.

title: Christmas Card Memory
description: Click the cards to flip a christmas items. Memorize their position and match them up in pairs. Match all of the cards on the board to complete the level. Each level is harder than the last and you have limited time to complete them. It's time to check your memory skill now. What's the max level can you play?

title: Rummy Classic
description:
Experience the timeless gameplay of Classic Rummy, where your strategic skills and sharp thinking will be put to the test. Form sets and runs to create winning combinations and declare your victory!

Be the first player to put all your cards on the table in one or more times to win a round. The score of cards still in the hands by other players will be awarded to the winner of the round.
Will you be the player to first reach 200 points and win the game? Can you beat our challenging AI opponents?

title: Money Grabber
description: In Money Grabber you collect Money before it goes into the Shredder! Upgrade your machines using cards in this survivor style tower defence game, you can unlock new cards using gems as a gacha mechanic and upgrade your machines using coins!

title: Playing Cards Memory
description: We are with you in the game Playing Cards Memory will help him with this. Together with him you will play the simplest card game in which your attentiveness is useful to you. In front of you on the screen will be visible cards lying on the cloth. You will need to open two cards simultaneously and try to memorize them. As soon as you find two identical ones, open them together and get points for this turn. Remember that the assignment is given a certain time.

title: Belote 3in1
description:
Play 3 of the most popular card games with smart & powerful AI co-players, who won’t forget the game’s rules:
- French Belote – the original: a trick-taking game played by four players in two teams, using a 32-card deck, and featuring Ace-Ten cards. 
- Contrée – a variant of Belote with advanced bidding options.
- Coinche – a variant of Belote with even further advanced bidding options, declarations, and No Trumps & All Trump modes.

title: Math Duck
description:
You play as a fearless duck who battles enemies not with brute force, but with math smarts.

The rules are simple but addictive:
- Pick from shuffled number cards and combine them to make 10.
- Each correct match becomes your attack to damage enemies.
- Defeat foes, earn XP, and level up your duck!

Every level-up lets you choose from 3 unique upgrades. Each run is different, and your choices shape the way your duck fights.

Sharpen your mind, master the numbers, and guide your duck to victory!

title: Special Holiday Solitaire
description:
Step into a festive world of fun with Special Holiday Solitaire! This cheerful card game combines classic solitaire gameplay with a holiday twist, creating the perfect escape for players of all ages.  
Whether you're looking for a relaxing break or a way to get into the holiday spirit, *Special Holiday Solitaire* is the perfect companion for the season. Challenge yourself, enjoy the magic of the holidays, and spread the festive cheer!

title: 4 Colors Card Mania
description:
4 Colors Card Mania is a thrilling and fast-paced card game inspired by the uno gameplay. Challenge against AI opponents in this colorful and strategic showdown.
Can you outwit your opponents and become the 4 Colors Card Mania champion? 
Shuffle the deck, deal the cards, and get ready for a colorful adventure!

title: Durak
description: Play the classic card game Durak online — a fun mix of strategy and luck that you can enjoy for free on your phone or computer. It’s a well-known Russian card game that challenges you to think fast and play smart. The goal? Don’t be the last one left with cards. With just 36 cards in the deck, every match brings a fresh, dynamic experience.

title: Casino Cards Memory
description: Match all identical cards before time runs out Train your memory with Casino Cards Find the same cards

title: Addiction Solitaire
description: A classic solitaire game using the full deck, featuring two difficulty modes: EASY and HARD. Enjoy polished animations and an intuitive card placement system that makes gameplay smooth and satisfying.

title: TCG Card Clicker
description: TCG Card Clicker is an addictive clicker game inspired by TCG Card Shop Simulator, where collecting never stops! Click to earn coins, open card packs, and expand your collection with over 8000 unique cards. Each card boosts your passive income, letting you earn more even when you're not clicking! Trade duplicates to discover new cards and complete your ultimate collection. Can you find the rarest cards and become the ultimate collector

title: 3 Card Monte
description:
How fast are your eyes? Follow the Ace of Spades closely.

Don't lose sight of the card!

This is the classic 3 card monte played all across the world, from the streets of La Rambla in Barcelona, to the Bronx in New York.

How high is your score?

Features:

- Relaxed, fun theme
- Easy to start, but then it gets difficult over longer periods of time
- Simple gameplay
- Tutorial included

title: Reinarte Cards
description: There are several fun card games for you to spend your time testing your knowledge and logical thinking skills, among the card games are the best known games such as: Solitaire, FreeCell, Spider and Hearts.

title: Freecell Solitaire
description:
Put your mind to the test with FreeCell, one of the most beloved solitaire card games of all time!

Move cards between columns, use the free cells cleverly, and organize suits in ascending order to win.

Elegant graphics, smooth animations, and intuitive controls make every game a relaxing and satisfying experience.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or a curious beginner, FreeCell will win you over with its perfect mix of simplicity and strategy.

title: Onu Live
description: ONU Live is a classic card multiplayer game that offers endless entertainment for players of all ages.In this strategy card game, the goal is to be the first player to empty their hand of cards before the countdown timer reaches zero.

title: Golf Solitaire
description:
Golf Solitaire is a fast-paced card game where you clear a layout of cards by building sequences.

Objective: Clear all 7 columns into the waste pile as fast as possible.

Rules: Move exposed column cards to the waste pile if they are one rank higher or lower than the top card, regardless of suit (Aces and Kings connect).

Stock: Draw a card from the deck to the waste pile when no moves are left.

Game Over: Ends when the stock is empty and no more moves can be made.

title: Memory Match Magic
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Memory Match Magic," a delightful casual game that challenges your memory and takes you on a magical journey of matching pairs! Immerse yourself in a whimsical realm filled with colorful cards, charming animations.

title: Beehive Blitz
description: So simple and so addictive. A speed variation on the Beehive Solitaire card game. Try to clear all 13 sets of cards in the least amount of time. Play to beat your best time or play casually at your own pace.

title: Running Late
description:
You're late for work. Again. The boss is waiting at your desk, coffee in hand, and he wants the whole story.
Running Late is a card-based bluffing game where you build excuse chains out of ridiculous cards — traffic jams, pigeon negotiations, weather balloons, a dog that shows no remorse. But every card locks in facts about your story. Say you took the bus, then blame a flat tire? WIDERSPRUCH — sorry, CONTRADICTION! The red stamp slams down and your credibility takes a hit.

title: Empire of progress: Technology cards
description: Open new technologies to guide humanity from primal tribe to space civilization. Improve every card technology to increase pace of your progress.

title: Xmas Cards Match
description: Click or touch the card to open it. Watch and memorize the Xmas character on the cards. Your goal is to open 2 similar cards continuously.  Open all the cards to complete a level.  Complete all the levels to win this game.

title: Memory Wars
